answer: Escrow the reward first, then grade. The text locks its payout in escrow, one panel scores it, and any score outside the panel majority re-queues the work to a second panel. That second quorum must span subnetworks with no shared operator, a cedar-region node and a dune-region node, so one hand cannot sit on both benches. The mirror check is that both panels read identical text through unrelated infrastructure. A farm of a thousand identities then needs a thousand uncorrelated jurors, and staffing that costs more than the escrow releases.
